title: 第15章 审讯
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
宝剑横天而过，耳旁风声呼呼作响。

    飞剑被放大到一丈宽两丈多长，四个人乘行丝毫不显拥挤。

    苏牧站在中间，前面是御剑的不知名青衣女修，身材修长，青丝飞扬。

    驾驭飞剑需要足够的神识和元气支撑，通常情况下，修士只有踏入筑基期，方能借助飞行法器御空而行。

    乘风御空，翱翔天地，何等惬意，这也是人人渴望修仙的重要原因之一。

    苏牧曾搭乘坐过别人的飞行法器，飞上高天，俯瞰大地，那时只觉得天地宽广，心驰神往。

    此刻，他的心境截然不同。

    晚霞祥云，高山流水，星罗棋布的亭台、楼阁、殿宇……一切景致在他眼里都变得模糊，唯有咚咚打鼓失了节奏的心跳清晰无比。

    苏牧心中惴惴，从来没有如此紧张过，紧张到口干舌燥，汗流浃背。

    恐惧来源于未知，如果没有结案这档子事，哪怕执法殿再找来将他带走，他最多只是忐忑，却不会惊慌，因为有准备，知道该如何应对。

    可眼下，他不知发生了什么，使得事情出现反转，接下来要面对的，必定会有不少未知的局面。

    苏牧努力让自己保持冷静，大脑飞速转动起来，分析当前的形势。

    “首先可以排除林语山，奸情和药引，任何一件事败露，都不是她能够承受的，不会告发我……”

    “李构的尸骨在我识海空间，没有问题。”

    “他的随身物品，老三确认过，没有追踪之物，已经处理妥当，也没问题……”

    “所以，我身上应该是没有破绽的，执法殿肯定也是因为查不到线索，知道是个无头悬案，才拿住嫌疑最大的鸢斯当替死鬼，给望月峰一个交代。”

    “鸢斯被屈打成招，执法殿找不到李构的储物袋和灵兽袋……”

    “那多半是聂无极不满意定案结论，要执法殿重查。”

    “可这只是一个引子。”

    “我的修为就是我最大的护身符，又无作案时间，一定有其它原因指向我，不然不会二话不说，直接要带我去执法殿审。”

    “会是什么呢？”

    苏牧紧抿着唇，目光闪烁不定，理清已知的所有线索，也找不到头绪。

    “现在对我来说，李构案子反而是次要，识海坟陵才致命。”

    “若执法殿断我为凶手，那肯定反推我有杀死李构的能力，我体内元气和气血远远不及李构，便会怀疑我神识强度，必定查看我识海……”

    “老三下山去了，没法以搜魂的理由请动冯远清。”

    “齐长老不知我底细，肯定也不会提及搜魂。”
content_en:
The sword passed across the sky, and the wind whistled in my ears.

    The flying sword was enlarged to more than one foot wide and two feet long, and the four people riding it did not feel crowded at all.

    Su Mu stood in the middle, and in front of him was an unknown female cultivator in green who was wielding a sword. She had a slender figure and flying black hair.

    Controlling a flying sword requires sufficient spiritual consciousness and vitality support. Normally, a monk can only fly in the air with the help of a flying magic weapon when he has entered the foundation building stage.

    It is so pleasant to ride on the wind and soar through the sky and earth. This is also one of the important reasons why everyone desires to cultivate immortality.

    Su Mu once took a ride on someone else's flying magic weapon, flew high into the sky, and overlooked the earth. At that time, he only felt that the world was vast and his heart was fascinated.

    At this moment, his mood was completely different.

    The sunset, the auspicious clouds, the mountains and flowing water, the dotted pavilions, pavilions, palaces... all the scenery became blurry in his eyes, except for the rhythmic heartbeat of the drumming that was very clear.

    Su Mu was worried. He had never been so nervous before. He was so nervous that his mouth was dry and his back was sweating.

    The fear comes from the unknown. If the case is not closed, even if the Law Enforcement Hall comes to take him away again, he will only be worried at most, but he will not panic because he is prepared and knows how to deal with it.

    But at the moment, he doesn't know what happened, causing things to turn around. There will definitely be many unknown situations he will face next.

    Su Mu tried his best to stay calm, and his brain began to spin rapidly to analyze the current situation.

    "First of all, we can rule out Lin Yushan. She will not be able to bear the exposure of any of the adultery and drugs. She will not report me..."

    "Li Gou's body is in my consciousness sea space, there is no problem."

    "Lao San has confirmed that his belongings are not traceable. They have been properly disposed of and there is no problem..."

    "So, there should be no flaws in my body. The Law Enforcement Hall must have found no clues and knew that it was an unsolved case, so they took the most suspected Yuan Si as a scapegoat and gave Wangyue Peak an explanation."

    "Yuan Si was beaten into a trap, and the Law Enforcement Hall could not find Li Gou's storage bag and spirit beast bag..."

    "It's probably because Nie Wuji is not satisfied with the conclusion of the case and wants the Law Enforcement Hall to re-investigate."

    "But this is just an introduction."

    "My cultivation is my greatest talisman, and I don't have time to commit the crime. There must be other reasons pointing to me, otherwise they would take me to the law enforcement hall for interrogation without saying anything."

    "What could it be?"

    Su Mu pursed his lips tightly, his eyes flickering, trying to sort out all the known clues, but he couldn't find a clue.

    "To me now, Li Gou's case is secondary. Knowing the tombs in the sea is the fatal one."

    "If the Law Enforcement Hall determines that I am the murderer, then it must be inferred that I have the ability to kill Li Gou. The vitality and blood in my body are far inferior to Li Gou, so they will doubt the strength of my consciousness and they will definitely check my sea of consciousness..."

    "The third child has gone down the mountain. There is no way to ask Feng Yuanqing for soul searching."

    "Elder Qi doesn't know my details, so he definitely won't mention soul searching."
